'''Kiera Swan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]-turned-[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:KieraSwan-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Swan, armed with an [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]]]]
She had a price on her head from her life of piracy, and as such, did not trust other bounty hunters and worked alone. Swan was also a two-time winner of the [[Obsidian Sphere/Legends|Obsidian Sphere]]. Eventually, her success as a bounty hunter caught the attention of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] who wanted her to compete with other bounty hunters in the [[Box/Legends|Box]], a death machine designed by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to win the honor of kidnapping [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. She witnessed [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] murder another bounty hunter [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]] to get his hat.

Soon, Dooku briefed everyone on the challenge the bounty hunters had to face including telling them about The Box. They were all deprived of their weapons and soon they entered The Box.
Their first challenge was to escape a room that was filling with [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas. Platforms began to rise from the ground and all the bounty hunters including Swan climbed on top of them. Another bounty hunter, [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] who was actually [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise found a secret tunnel underneath the ground. All the hunters followed him through the tunnel, thus surviving the first round. However, Swan met her fate in the second round.

Ledges began to slide out of the walls with a [[Electrified laser blade/Legends|sword]] resembling a lightsaber swinging around on its front. Bulduga's brother [[Onca/Legends|Onca]] quickly fell prey to the blades. As before, Hardeen saw an open tunnel on the ceiling. Using the ledges, he and Bane hopped to the top towards the tunnel with the other bounty hunters following behind. In her attempt to escape this challenge, Kiera was hit by one of the ledges and the light blade impaled her, killing her instantly.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Ashley Eckstein]], who also voices [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', voiced Kiera Swan. Kiera Swan was a reference to [[Keira Knightley]], who previously played Amidala's handmaiden [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> as well as Knightley's character [[w:c:pirates:Elizabeth Swann|Elizabeth Swann]] from from the [[w:c:pirates:Pirates of the Caribbean|''Pirates of the Caribbean'']] movies.<ref name="SW-The Box - The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep417|text="The Box" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|slide 2 caption}}</ref> Knightley's name was misspelled as "Kiera" in the ending credits to ''The Phantom Menace''.<ref name="Episode I" /> Furthermore, the pirate-turned-bounty hunter's accolade, "two-time winner of the [[Obsidian Sphere]]" was presumably a championship, but the name actually derived from the ''[[w:c:pirates:Black Pearl|Black Pearl]]'',<ref name="SW-The Box - The Clone Wars Episode Guide" /> [[w:c:pirates:Jack Sparrow|Jack Sparrow]]'s pirate ship which was once compared to the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="Prop Culture">{{DisneyPlus|url=series/disney-prop-culture/3vXywewCCYr5|text=Prop Culture|archivedate=20200515070401|quote=And so, the Black Pearl, we needed it to feel very different than the others. It's haunted, it's a special place. Wherever you look, you feel like you're being watched. This idea that the sails actually had personality to it, the way they were ripped, they almost had faces coming out. And yet, it's Jack Sparrow's Millennium Falcon. You know? It's his ship that he loves so much. So you have to not hate it, you actually have to think it's kind of beautiful.}}</ref>
